Question: As Salaam alykum, I want to know the meaning of one dream my husband saw He saw he has turned almost bald(only few hairs on head) and then someone told that there is this oil in the shop which can bring it back,after that he cant remember.. Please interpret this dream according to your knowledge. Jazakhumakhair. Answer ID: 9379 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 242/1882=H/1429) There is negligence towards religious matters especially fulfilling the due rights and having good conduct. This is the meaning of the dream. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
